# Third-party design reference

EDUNEXUS Business OS visual work was adapted from the user-supplied **Tailwindadmin React Free 1.0.0** reference.

The supplied archive identifies the reference as MIT licensed and credits Tailwindadmin / development team. This project does not copy the reference application wholesale; it selectively adapts visual patterns and dashboard composition to EDUNEXUS's existing Next.js, Supabase, multi-tenant and education workflows.
